ariaLabel.open: The flap open: it lies flat in the chute wall and pieces fall on down the chute.
ariaLabel.closed: The flap closed: it crosses the chute and turns pieces down the funnel into this layer.

hint.noChannel: Choose the channel its servo is wired to (under Advanced), save the layers, then home the machine to move its flap.
hint.unsaved: Save the layers, then home the machine to move its flap.
hint.needsHome: Home the machine to move its flap.

status.saveSettingsFailed: Failed to save servo layer settings

validation.needsChannel: Layer {layer} needs a channel while it is active.
validation.binLimit: {label}'s bin limit must be a whole number above 0.
validation.settleAdjust: {label}'s settle adjustment must be a whole number of milliseconds.

alert.wrongBackend: This calibrator is for the PCA9685 (PWM) servo backend, and this machine is set up for the Waveshare bus.

flapDiagram.openDescription: The flap lies flat in the chute wall, so pieces fall past it to the layers below.
flapDiagram.closedDescription: The flap crosses the chute, so pieces slide down this layer's funnel into its bins.

instructions.moveFlap: For each layer, move its flap with the arrows (or the arrow keys) until it looks like the picture, then lock that angle: open first, then closed. A layer sorts once both are locked.
instructions.stepOpen: Move the flap until it lies flat in the chute wall, then lock it open.
instructions.stepClosed: Now move the flap until it crosses the chute, then lock it closed.

badge.moveHint: Up and down move its flap 1°, left and right 5°; Escape lets go

bins.label: Bins
bins.info: How many bins sit around the chute on this layer. Match the bins fitted on it: {counts}.

binLimit.label: Bin limit
binLimit.info: The most pieces one bin on this layer takes. When a bin reaches it, the machine counts that bin full and sends the category's next pieces to another bin. Leave it empty for no limit.

channel.label: Channel
channel.info: The servo output on the control board that this layer's flap servo is plugged into.

settle.label: Settle adjust
settle.info: Computed wait after a drop: {base}ms. Adjustment applies on top; total: {total}ms.

servoSpeedSettings.panelDescription: For every layer. The standard speed is used at startup and for jogging.

hourlyChart.ariaLabelHint: Use the arrow keys to read each hour.

localDataPanel.confirmMessage: Every training sample on this machine is deleted, including the ones no Hive has yet. This cannot be undone.
localDataPanel.deletedFallback: Deleted every sample on this machine.
localDataPanel.loadErrorPrefix: Couldn't load what is stored here: {message}
localDataPanel.deleteButtonLabel: Delete all samples on this machine
localDataPanel.panelDescription: Kept here until every Hive that should have it does.
localDataPanel.nothingStored: Nothing is stored on this machine.

diskStatus.low: free on the disk, so no samples are saved until there is {min} free.
diskStatus.ok: free on the disk. Saving samples stops below {min} free.

sharingPanel.loadErrorPrefix: Couldn't load what this sorter shares: {message}

alertTitle.needsConsent: Nothing is shared with a Hive yet
alertTitle.needsReview: What this sorter shares has changed

alertBody.needsConsent: Look over the list, then agree to start sharing it.
alertBody.needsReview: Machine telemetry is new. Look over the list, then press OK.

sharingPanel.sharedWithInfo: Every Hive gets the same unless you set one differently. Choose a Hive to see and change what it receives.

description.noHive: No Hive is connected yet. What you choose here applies to each one you connect.
description.default: What each Hive may receive. The icon after a name says what it is for.

sharingPanel.resetToEveryHiveHelp: Every Hive gets this {state}. Give {hive} the same.

ring.name: Ring
ring.help: The band pieces ride, at the rim.

drop.name: Drop
drop.help: Where pieces land from the channel before.

precise.name: Precise
precise.help: The sliver before the exit, where pieces are let off one at a time.

exit.name: Exit
exit.help: Where pieces leave, along the rim at the opening.

zonePanel.emptyState: No zones yet. Find them in the picture, then adjust and save.
zonePanel.footerFallback: The zones change only when someone saves them. Lock a part to keep Find from moving it.
